title: Gaussian Integral of a Quadratic Expression
statement:
Let $I$ be a finite type, let $c:I\to\mathbb R$, and let $v\ge0$ with $v\ne0$. For any $i,j\in I$,
\[
\int_{\mathbb R^I}\left(\frac{(z_i-c_i)^2+(z_j-c_j)^2}{2v^2}+\frac1v\right)\,d\Bigl(\bigotimes_{k\in I}N(c_k,v)\Bigr)(z)=\frac2v,
\]
where each $N(c_k,v)$ is a Gaussian measure with mean $c_k$ and variance parameter $v$.
replaced: Let $I$ be a finite set, $c\in\mathbb R^I$, $v>0$, and $\mu_{c,v}=\bigotimes_{i\in I}N(c_i,v)$. Put $B_{ij}(z)=((z_i-c_i)^2+(z_j-c_j)^2)/(2v^2)+1/v$. For all $i,j\in I$, $\int B_{ij}\,d\mu_{c,v}=2/v$.
